target.title: fix(anthropic): add claude-fable-5 to CLI allowlist, aliases, labels, and context window
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`claude-fable-5` — a production Anthropic model — is completely missing from the CLI provider path (`extensions/anthropic/cli-constants.ts` + `cli-catalog.ts`), while the direct Anthropic provider path (`register.runtime.ts`) already has full support via `isAnthropicFable5Model()` / `resolveAnthropicFixedContextWindow()`.

Four metadata layers were missing:

| Layer | File | Consequence |
|-------|------|-------------|
| allowlist (`CLAUDE_CLI_DEFAULT_ALLOWLIST_REFS`) | `cli-constants.ts` | `openclaw configure` cannot select fable-5 |
| aliases (`CLAUDE_CLI_MODEL_ALIASES`) | `cli-constants.ts` | `fable` / `fable-5` aliases unresolvable |
| label (`CLAUDE_CLI_MODEL_LABELS`) | `cli-catalog.ts` | Falls back to bare `${id} (Claude CLI)` |
| context window (`CLAUDE_CLI_CONTEXT_WINDOWS`) | `cli-catalog.ts` | Falls back to 200K instead of 1M |

This is the same root cause as #100572: a new model was registered in the direct API path but the CLI path's independently-maintained constants were not updated.

## Why This Change Was Made

Add fable-5 entries to the four CLI metadata layers, matching the contracts already established in `register.runtime.ts`:
- `resolveAnthropicFixedContextWindow()` → `ANTHROPIC_FABLE_CONTEXT_TOKENS` (1_000_000)
- `isAnthropicFable5Model()` → recognized as a Claude 5 family model
- `isAnthropic128kOutputModel()` → 128K max output

The minimal fix (pure data append) was chosen over a synchronization refactor because:
- Lowest risk, fully consistent with surrounding code patterns
- Directly resolves all four missing dimensions
- A synchronization mechanism can be addressed separately

## User Impact

- `openclaw configure` can now select `claude-fable-5` for the Claude CLI provider
- Aliases `fable` / `fable-5` / `claude-fable-5` resolve correctly
- Context window is correctly set to 1M tokens (was 200K)
- Model picker shows the friendly label "Claude Fable 5 (Claude CLI)"

## Evidence

- `npx vitest run extensions/anthropic/cli-shared.test.ts` — 21/21 passed
- `npx vitest run extensions/anthropic/index.test.ts` — 37/37 passed
- Diff: 2 files, +12/-1 lines (pure data append, no logic changes)
- Lock file check: no `pnpm-lock.yaml` in diff
- Review: PASSED — no findings

Behavior addressed: claude-fable-5 missing from CLI provider allowlist, aliases, labels, and context window
Real environment tested: Linux Node 24, local vitest
Exact steps or command run after this patch: `npx vitest run extensions/anthropic/cli-shared.test.ts extensions/anthropic/index.test.ts`
Evidence after fix: All 58 tests pass; `buildClaudeCliCatalogEntries()` includes `claude-fable-5` with label "Claude Fable 5 (Claude CLI)", 1M context window, and 2576px max image side
Observed result after fix: CLI catalog entry complete, aliases resolve correctly, sonnet-5 entries preserved
What was not tested: End-to-end `openclaw configure` interactive flow (requires Claude CLI subscription environment)
